message.content:
This editorial illustration is designed like a reversible playing card within a blue-bordered rectangle. A central figure is depicted twice, with the bottom half mirrored and inverted. Both figures have light blue skin, stylized facial features with closed eyes, and a slight smile. They wear black jackets with gold trim, white shirts, and black bowties. Each figure holds a wavy-bladed dagger with a gold hilt. A yellow and blue geometric sash crosses diagonally behind the figures.

The text "TEMPO" appears in large red letters at both the top and bottom (inverted). Beside the figures, the phrase "JUNGKIR BALIK 'RAJA JAWA'" is written in black, also appearing normally and inverted. Black tree-like icons are positioned in two corners, and the letter "J" appears in the other two.

The top and bottom edges feature red bands. Small black text across the top and bottom includes "Bedol Desa Jaksa KPK H.82" and "Lobi-lobi Anggaran Prabowo H.98." Vertical text on the right side indicates "26 AGUSTUS-1 SEPTEMBER 2024" and "RP 50.000." A barcode and QR code are on the left.
